name: Nathanael
background: A Pharisee who has formed an unlikely alliance with the Herodians — normally political rivals — specifically to trap Jesus on the tax question. The threat Jesus posed to their relative power united them.

genericReactions.physical: A coin... yes, the denarius. His answer was... unexpected.
genericReactions.testimonial: We asked a simple question. He turned it back on us.
genericReactions.digital: The law is clear on our obligations. His interpretation was... clever.
genericReactions.environmental: This happened in the Temple court, in front of everyone. A public humiliation.
genericReactions.analytical: It was a simple binary choice. Pay or not pay. He found a third way.
genericReactions.prophecy: He speaks like a prophet, but his words undermine the Law.
